review_markdown.description: The full code review in markdown format

inline_comments.description: Inline comments anchored to specific diff lines. Only include when confident the line is in the diff.

issue_id.description: Must match a stable_id in new_findings or a still-open prior evaluation

file.description: Exact file path as it appears in the diff

line.description: End line number in the new file version

start_line.description: Required key. Start line for a multi-line range (must be < line), or null for single-line comments.

body.description: Detailed explanation for the inline comment

suggestion.description: Required key. Replacement code for a GitHub suggestion block, or null when no suggestion is available.

state.description: Machine-readable state for review continuity across runs

pr_summary.description: Brief summary of the PR for context in future reviews

new_findings.description: New findings only; the publisher combines these with prior evaluations and retained ledger state.

prior_issue_evaluations.description: One evaluation for every prior open ID when possible; the publisher carries missing IDs forward.

stable_id.description: Stable finding identity. Reuse the same ID only for the same frozen failure scenario.

reachability.description: How the failure is reached today. normal_path: ordinary use hits it. compound_path: every trigger in the chain must align. theoretical: no supported execution path in the merged code reaches it.

likelihood.description: How often the reachability chain is expected to occur in current production use.

likely_consequence.description: Most likely operational result when the complete reachability chain occurs.

worst_credible_consequence.description: Worst outcome supported by current evidence, not a merely conceivable one.

risk_rationale.description: Explain why the combined risk warrants repair, an owner decision, or follow-up.

disposition.description: Parent reviewer proposal; child finders do not choose this.

autonomous_eligibility.description: Parent reviewer proposal; AUTHOR_DECISION and FOLLOW_UP are NO.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete frozen failure scenario. Preserve for a prior finding.

approved_invariant.description: Invariant already approved by the PR or controlling owner decision.

where.description: Current target location; name both producer and consumer for cross-boundary findings.

evidence.description: Current-target code evidence connecting cause to failure scenario.

affected_lifecycle_planes.description: Relevant lifecycle planes from repository rules; [] when none apply.

stable_id.description: Stable finding identity. Reuse the same ID only for the same frozen failure scenario.

evidence.description: Current-target evidence for a closing result.

challenge_ref.description: Trusted github-comment:<id> of a considered evidence challenge.

decision_ref.description: Trusted github-comment:<id> of a controlling owner decision. Required for superseded_by_human_decision; may also accompany still_open or resolved_on_target when it matches the latest collected decision for this issue.
